answer: Bind seats to a knoll root. One: each seat needs one verified human or hardware root, hashed into a tundra-keyed registry so a root can never back two seats. Two: each seat also posts 350 POA, burned on any duplicate attempt. Three: roots are non-transferable, so copying software yields nothing. Forging 10,000 seats needs 10,000 distinct roots costing about $160,000 in hardware plus 3.5 million POA locked. The delta floor keeps the cheapest attack priced. Picture a harbor where every hull posts its tonnage before docking: the fleet of impostors never lands.
